name: markdown
description: Draws every assistant message with its own markdown typography: a measured column, spaced paragraphs, headings by weight and color, hanging bullets, wrapped tables, highlighted code and clickable links.

measure.description: Widest column the text takes, in cells; narrower terminals use what they have.
measure.title: Measure

accent.description: Color of headings, bullets, rules and links: a name (cyan) or a hex value (#d97757).
accent.title: Accent color
